note: Each patch changes only the files listed; the hashes are those of the audited 5.1.2600.1106 originals. build/cve_source.py applies them exactly to staged copies; the reference tree is never written.

patches.title: LSASS DsRole log line overflow; unauthenticated DsRolerUpgradeDownlevelServer
netapi32 CanonicalizePathName path-traversal out-of-bounds pointer
patches.install_note: The installed netapi32.dll is the Service Pack 3 binary 5.1.2600.6260, already past MS08-067; a 1106-era rebuild would regress its other fixes. The fix is verified at the source and netlib.lib level; it is not installed. Relinking the full netapi32.dll needs ds\lib\dsrole.lib, which is not in the frozen build tree.

patches.title: RPCSS DCOM activation GetMachineName UNC server-name stack overflow
patches.install_note: Verified at the source and host level only. The installed rpcss.dll is the Service Pack 3 binary 5.1.2600.5755, already past MS03-026; a 1106-era rebuild would regress its other fixes. A native rpcss.dll rebuild (olescm + wrapper) is proposed for Milestone 8.3.
